legend: Lena is a beautiful girl who likes logical puzzles.
As a gift for her birthday, Lena got a matrix puzzle!

The matrix consists of n%%ZSMJ0%% rows and m%%ZSMJ1%% columns, and each cell is either black or white. The coordinates (i,j)%%ZSMJ2%% denote the cell which belongs to the i%%ZSMJ3%%-th row and j%%ZSMJ4%%-th column for every 1≤i≤n%%ZSMJ5%% and 1≤j≤m%%ZSMJ6%%. To solve the puzzle, Lena has to choose a cell that minimizes the Manhattan distance to the farthest black cell from the chosen cell.

More formally, let there be k≥1%%ZSMJ7%% black cells in the matrix with coordinates (xi,yi)%%ZSMJ8%% for every 1≤i≤k%%ZSMJ9%%. Lena should choose a cell (a,b)%%ZSMJ10%% that minimizes kmaxi=1(|a−xi|+|b−yi|).%%ZSMJ11%%
As Lena has no skill, she asked you for help. Will you tell her the optimal cell to choose?
input: There are several test cases in the input data. The first line contains a single integer t%%ZSMJ12%% (1≤t≤10000%%ZSMJ13%%) — the number of test cases. This is followed by the test cases description.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n%%ZSMJ14%% and m%%ZSMJ15%% (2≤n,m≤1000%%ZSMJ16%%)  — the dimensions of the matrix.

The following n%%ZSMJ17%% lines contain m%%ZSMJ18%% characters each, each character is either 'W' or 'B'. The j%%ZSMJ19%%-th character in the i%%ZSMJ20%%-th of these lines is 'W' if the cell (i,j)%%ZSMJ21%% is white, and 'B' if the cell (i,j)%%ZSMJ22%% is black.
It is guaranteed that at least one black cell exists.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n⋅m%%ZSMJ23%% does not exceed 106%%ZSMJ24%%.
output: For each test case, output the optimal cell (a,b)%%ZSMJ25%% to choose. If multiple answers exist, output any.
note: In the first test case the two black cells have coordinates (1,1)%%ZSMJ26%% and (3,2)%%ZSMJ27%%. The four optimal cells are (1,2)%%ZSMJ28%%, (2,1)%%ZSMJ29%%, (2,2)%%ZSMJ30%% and (3,1)%%ZSMJ31%%. It can be shown that no other cell minimizes the maximum Manhattan distance to every black cell.
In the second test case it is optimal to choose the black cell (2,2)%%ZSMJ32%% with maximum Manhattan distance being 2%%ZSMJ33%%.
